comment: Two consecutive subsections carry the same number. "Integration Interfaces with Foundational DPI" begins as section 4.3.4 at L339 (p.96), and "Interoperability Implementation Pathways" begins as section 4.3.4 at L369 (p.97). "Minimum Conformance and Testing" then appears as 4.3.5 at L398 (p.98). The duplication is reproduced in the table of contents, so a reference to "section 4.3.4" is ambiguous.
